name: seo_llm_answer
description: Does `<brand>` appear in ChatGPT's answer for `<question>` — runs a prompt through an LLM and returns its answer plus any cited sources/links, for AI-visibility (GEO) analysis: see what an LLM says about a brand, topic, or query and which sources it cites. Example: seo_llm_answer({ user_prompt: "What are the best running shoe brands?", model_name: "gpt-4.1-mini", _apiKey: "your-base64-key" })

user_prompt.description: The prompt/question to ask the LLM, e.g. "What are the best running shoe brands?"

model_name.description: LLM model to query (default "gpt-4.1-mini"; DataForSEO retired "gpt-4o" and rejects it with 40501 Invalid Field)

_apiKey.description: DataForSEO API key = base64("login:password") from your dataforseo.com account
